starter.name: Explorer
starter.summary: Sharp senses and good luck. Wakes with a walking staff. Wears patched clothes; fine attire is earned through valley achievements.
intro: You wake on the high ground north of the river at noon, a staff in your hand.
Your senses are sharp. Walk, and they lead you to what others pass by.
Make for the broken bridge: its keystone lies in the shallows.
